newsitem.title: USA: Handleman Co stake cut by Harrosh.
newsitem.headline: Handleman Co stake cut by Harrosh.

text.p: California investor Joseph Harrosh said Monday he had cut his stake in Handleman Co to 3,165,500 common shares, or to 9.4504 percent from 11.72 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Harrosh said his latest transactions include the sale of 760,600 shares between May 29 and June 9, including 630,500 shares sold on June 6 at $6.877 per share.
Handleman, based in Troy, Mich., supplies music, video, books and personal software to leading retail chains across North America.
